name: skyflow-airline-assistant
description: SkyFlow Airlines multi-agent conversational customer service assistant featuring a Tool-First intent router and dedicated domain sub-agents.

variableDeclarations.name: chat_complete
variableDeclarations.description: true once a tool or exit callback has set terminal status

variableDeclarations.name: intent_id
variableDeclarations.description: Classified intent identifier from SkyFlow Intent Catalogue

variableDeclarations.name: target_agent
variableDeclarations.description: The child agent destination computed by the intent router tool

variableDeclarations.name: domain
variableDeclarations.description: Active domain: DAY_OF_TRAVEL, SALES, or GENERAL_FAQ

variableDeclarations.name: unclear_retry_count
variableDeclarations.description: Vague or ambiguous intent instances, counted before terminating

variableDeclarations.name: end_reason
variableDeclarations.description: Reason code when concluding chat session (e.g. COMPLETED, OUT_OF_SCOPE, UNDER_CONSTRUCTION)
